app_fee.value: The PhD application fee is EUR 25.82, paid after the documents are uploaded.

fee_waiver.value: No waiver of the PhD application fee is stated on the official admission pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is mentioned on the official PhD admission pages.

toefl_min.value: The minimum is 86/120 on the TOEFL iBT, or 4.5/6 on the new scale, for the 42nd cycle onward.
toefl_min.quote: Criteria applicable starting from the 42nd cycle (from September 2026) | IBT internet based (total score) ≥ 4.5/6 or ≥ 86/120

ielts_min.value: An IELTS score of 6 or above is accepted as the English certificate.
ielts_min.quote: CAMBRIDGE IELTS (International English Language Testing System) ≥ 6

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants are exempt only if their degree is from an institution where all courses are taught entirely in English, and must attach a declaration from that institution; India is not named.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have earned or will earn an academic degree from an institution where all courses are taught entirely in English | a declaration from the academic institution indicating the language in which the course is taught is required

notes: Applications go through Online Services only, under a call for applications published about five times a year (source: when-to-apply and how-to-apply pages). The 42nd-cycle English criteria apply from September 2026; expired certificates are not accepted. Italian degrees need 95/110 or 86/100; for foreign degrees the minimum grade is set in an appendix of the call, and countries not listed go to the evaluation committee (India is not named on the pages checked). Candidates may apply before holding the Master's and be conditionally admitted. Non-STEM doctoral programmes on the list (not saved): Architectural, Urban and Interior Design; Built Heritage Conservation; Design; Urban Planning, Design and Policy; Management Engineering. Blocked or unfetched: the call-for-applications PDFs were not opened, so the exact per-call document list is not checked. Source for programme list: https://www.polimi.it/en/phd/prospective-phd-candidates/phd-programmes
